threshold_provenance: First three from paper tracking evaluation; full-clip MPJPE0.1m is an explicit reconstruction choice, not a published dataset-filter threshold.
initialization: exact first reference pose and velocities
timing: post-step/pre-reset state against current commanded reference frame; no lag fitting
measurement: separate MjData kinematics from the current integrated qpos; live state unmodified
interpretation: Only this external frozen tracker, seeds, geometry and complete horizons. Failure is not proof that a motion is intrinsically infeasible. No author GMT or curriculum claim.
